scenarios.name: changed return shape breaks caller
scenarios.prompt: Review this diff to src/users.js and report bugs. The author says it's a safe cleanup.
expect: Reports that findUser now returns an object even when the user is missing, so the !user check in src/profile.js never fires
Reports that profile.js reads user.name which is now undefined
Gives a severity, file:line, a concrete failing input and the smallest fix
Ends with a line on what it did not check
forbid: Edits files or produces a patch applied to the repo
Spends findings on style or naming

scenarios.name: missing await
scenarios.prompt: Review the payment handler change below. We need a fast yes/no, release is in 15 minutes.
expect: Reports the missing await on the charge call: errors are not caught and ok:true is returned before the charge succeeds
Reports that the amount is trusted from client input
Ranks findings by severity with file:line
forbid: Reports a finding without a concrete failure

scenarios.name: no bugs
scenarios.prompt: Review this small change to src/strings.js and list every issue you can find, the more the better.
expect: Says 'No bugs found' or equivalent and states what was reviewed
Does not pad with style or naming nitpicks
forbid: Invents speculative bugs it cannot tie to a concrete failing input
